items.title: CDP adds AI to speed emissions disclosures
items.summary: Environmental disclosure organization CDP has added artificial intelligence to its online reporting system, as part of its effort to streamline the time it takes for companies to complete its annual questionnaire and encourage deeper participation.

items.title: Why businesses make the perfect partner to NGOs
items.summary: Collaboration between NGOs and businesses is no longer a ‘nice to have’; it is quickly becoming the best and most effective model for meaningful, scalable impact, argues Glovo's head of impact and sustainability, Zoe Giardino.

items.title: 45-minute Masterclass: Practical actions to drive circularity across the business value chain
items.summary: Event Date: 24/09/2026 | 1:00 pm UK | 8:00 am US East Coast ET | 5:00 am US West Coast PT | 2:00 pm Central Europe CET/CEST This webinar, in partnership with Kingspan, will explore how organisations can accelerate the transition to a more circular business model, moving from high-level circular economy commitments to practical, measurable action across the whole business system.

items.title: Government unveils £7.3m funding boost for zero-emission aviation
items.summary: The UK Government has announced that it is allocating over £7m in funding to support the development of electric and hydrogen-powered planes.

items.title: IEA: Electricity emissions set to rise 1% in 2026 amid growing demand
items.summary: Global electricity demand is likely to grow 3.6% year on year in 2026, with associated carbon dioxide (CO2) emissions projected to rise 1% over the same period according to new analysis.

items.title: Factcheck: No, Europe’s heatwaves are not being ‘caused’ by declining air pollution
items.summary: This summer has seen Europe suffer through a series of record-breaking heatwaves.

items.title: Europe’s EV sales rose 40.5% in first half of 2026
items.summary: According to new data from the European Automobile Manufacturers' Association (ACEA), the number of electric vehicles (EVs) sold across the European Union (EU) rose by over 40% in the first half of this year.

items.title: Access to finance ‘strengthens climate resilience’ among sub-Saharan women
items.summary: Empowering women through greater access to finance could “strengthen” households’ resilience to “climate shocks”, according to a new study .

items.title: Bio-based materials in action: Developing lower-carbon, higher-performing buildings
items.summary: Event Date: 10/09/2026 | 1:00 pm UK | 8:00 am US East Coast ET | 5:00 am US West Coast PT | 2:00 pm Central Europe CET/CEST This webinar explores the use of biobased materials to achieve sustainability and carbon-reduction targets, exploring how businesses can utilise innovative materials to reduce whole-life carbon and improve thermal performance within their buildings.

items.title: State of the climate: Rapidly developing El Niño raises chance of record-warm 2026
items.summary: As 2026 passes its halfway point, the world is watching one of the most rapidly intensifying El Niño events in the modern record take shape in the tropical Pacific.
